outcome: Prenatal and postnatal outcome correlation with ultrasound findings
Sensitivity of prenatal ultrasound in T18 detection
cohort: 60 pregnancies diagnosed with Trisomy 18, all having prenatally detected ultrasound anomalies.
finding: Prenatal ultrasound is highly sensitive for detecting Trisomy 18 but is not predictive of the outcome in continued pregnancies, and Trisomy 18 should not be considered a uniformly lethal syndrome.
